title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: supervisors can edit and override submitted quality evaluations
summary: The documented edit workflow, permissions and both control APIs support this briefing. Clarify that the user security-role screen manages direct assignments only; the specific credit rate for edits and override audit event names remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Supervisors can reopen a submitted quality evaluation, modify answers and resubmit it.
claims.quote: Edit evaluations and modify responses in an evaluation after it's submitted. When you submit an evaluation, it initially appears in a read-only view. Select Edit to update answers and then submit the changes.

claims.claim: The roadmap says completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity.
claims.quote: While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified

claims.claim: The roadmap describes an Edit action for discrepancies such as incorrect AI predictions or manual assessment errors.
claims.quote: supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The roadmap says the capability covers AI-assisted, AI agent-generated and manual evaluations.
claims.quote: The capability is available across AI-assisted, AI agent-generated, and manual evaluations, providing a consistent correction experience.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes editing evaluations marked completed or expired.
claims.quote: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired.

claims.claim: An override can change a recorded evaluation score, including one produced by an AI agent or a manual evaluator.
claims.quote: In edit mode, supervisors can update evaluation responses, adjust scores, and refine comments to reflect an accurate assessment.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap says audit signals track who made an edit.
claims.quote: All changes are tracked through audit signals, including who made the edit and when

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap says audit signals track when an edit was made.
claims.quote: All changes are tracked through audit signals, including who made the edit and when

claims.claim: The roadmap says overridden evaluations are flagged.
claims.quote: overridden evaluations are clearly flagged.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes overrides as producing a final validated evaluation record for reporting and compliance reviews.
claims.quote: This ensures that evaluation records represent the final, validated view of agent performance and interaction quality.

claims.claim: The edit route is Copilot Service workspace > Service > Evaluations > completed evaluation > Edit, followed by updating answers and Submit.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service workspace, go to Evaluations in Service. Select and open an evaluation with the status Completed. Select Edit. Update the answers as required. Select Submit to apply your changes.

claims.claim: A completed evaluation opens read-only and returns to the submitted read-only state after resubmission.
claims.quote: The evaluation opens in a read-only view and indicates that it's submitted. After you submit, the evaluation returns to the submitted (read-only) state.

claims.claim: Changes do not take effect until the evaluator submits them.
claims.quote: Select Submit to apply your changes. Your changes don't take effect until you submit.

claims.claim: In progress evaluations cannot be edited and Edit is disabled for nonsubmitted evaluations.
claims.quote: You can't edit evaluations that are in In progress status. The Edit action remains disabled for nonsubmitted evaluations.

claims.claim: Learn requires an evaluation to be submitted (completed) before editing.
claims.quote: The evaluation must be submitted (completed).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn names Quality Admin as a role permitting edits to submitted evaluations.
claims.quote: You have the Quality Admin or the Quality Manager role, or the Override submitted evaluation (Miscellaneous privilege) added to your role.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn names Quality Manager as a role permitting edits to submitted evaluations.
claims.quote: You have the Quality Admin or the Quality Manager role, or the Override submitted evaluation (Miscellaneous privilege) added to your role.

claims.claim: The alternative override permission is Override Submitted evaluation (prvOverrideSubmittedEval), a miscellaneous privilege on Evaluation (msdyn_evaluation).
claims.quote: In Power Platform admin center, search for the Evaluation (msdyn_evaluation) table and the Miscellaneous privileges > Override Submitted evaluation (prvOverrideSubmittedEval) privilege.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: A role other than the named quality roles can permit overrides when it includes the override privilege.
claims.quote: You have the Quality Admin or the Quality Manager role, or the Override submitted evaluation (Miscellaneous privilege) added to your role.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn describes Expired as past the evaluation due date and no longer openable by the evaluator, unlike the roadmap's completed-or-expired editing description.
claims.quote: Expired | The due date provided in the evaluation criteria expired and the evaluator can no longer open the evaluation.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn says the system regenerates the evaluation summary on submission when responses have changed.
claims.quote: As an evaluator, when you update evaluation responses, the system regenerates the summary upon submission to reflect the finalized evaluation.

claims.claim: Summary regeneration is skipped when nothing changed to optimize performance and cost.
claims.quote: If you don't make any changes, the system skips summary regeneration to optimize performance and cost.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The Evaluation table has a Submission Overridden column indicating whether the evaluation submission has been overridden.
claims.quote: Description | Indicates whether the evaluation submission has been overridden. DisplayName | Submission Overridden. LogicalName | msdyn_isevaluationedited. Type | Boolean.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly stated Edit's arrival default or a separate administrative enablement step for Edit.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 quality evaluation edit submitted evaluations Edit enable default admin switch; "submitted evaluations" "default" "enable". Read roadmap, Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation and Evaluation Global Config; no Edit-specific arrival default.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the feature documentation describes a new data source introduced by editing an existing evaluation.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 quality evaluation edit submitted evaluations Edit enable default admin switch. Read roadmap description, Use evaluations > Edit submitted evaluations and Manage quality evaluation; editing is described as updating existing responses, not adding a data source.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation requests consent for potential data movement across regions.
claims.quote: To participate, customers are requested to provide consent for potential data movement across regions.

claims.claim: Service calls may be routed outside the customer's regional boundary if local capacity is temporarily unavailable.
claims.quote: For optimal performance, the system might route service calls outside the customer's regional boundary if local capacity is temporarily unavailable.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft says quality evaluation should not determine employment decisions including compensation, rewards, seniority or other rights.
claims.quote: It isn't intended to be used, and shouldn't be used, to make decisions that affect the employment of an employee or group of employees, including compensation, rewards, seniority, or other rights or entitlements.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation lists setting up Microsoft Copilot credits as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: Assign the Quality Manager, Quality Evaluator, and Quality Administrator roles. Set up Microsoft Copilot credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; front matter: cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Quality evaluation uses Copilot-credit consumption, supporting the consumption licensing model and variable cost rating.
claims.quote: forecast their monthly Copilot credit consumption across multiple AI agents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Copilot Studio. Dynamics 365 Service: Case Management, Customer Intent, and Quality Evaluation Agents

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 use consumption-based billing charging per use.
claims.quote: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 use consumption-based billing, charging per use. These capabilities use Copilot Credits for AI interactions and tasks

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 supports prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go billing models.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 supports two billing models: prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go.

claims.claim: Microsoft's agent usage estimator includes the Quality Evaluation Agent among Dynamics 365 Service agents for forecasting credit consumption.
claims.quote: It supports multiple agent types across: Dynamics 365 Service: Case Management, Customer Intent, and Quality Evaluation Agents

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a credit rate specific to editing a submitted quality evaluation.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Quality Evaluation Agent Copilot credits rate edit submitted regenerate summary cost. Read Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation, setup-pay-as-you-go, Agent usage estimator and Billing rates and management; no edit-specific rate.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a credit rate specifically for regenerating an evaluation summary.
claims.quote: Searched: "Quality Evaluation" "regeneration" "credits" rate. Read Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation, setup-pay-as-you-go, Agent usage estimator and Billing rates and management; no evaluation-summary regeneration rate.

claims.claim: The Use evaluations page names no additional licence beyond its prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Quality Evaluation Agent Copilot credits rate edit submitted regenerate summary cost. Read all of Use evaluations: prerequisites are enable quality evaluation, required roles and privileges, Copilot credits and regional data consent; no further named licence appears.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation's general prerequisites list assigning Quality Manager, Quality Evaluator and Quality Administrator roles.
claims.quote: Assign the Quality Manager, Quality Evaluator, and Quality Administrator roles.

claims.claim: Quality evaluation requires Enable AI agents turned on for the Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Turn on Enable AI agents for your Dynamics 365 environment in Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Security role assignment in Power Platform admin center is made in a selected environment.
claims.quote: In the Manage pane, select Environments, and then select an environment from the list. Select Settings. Select Users + permissions, and then select Users.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Manage security roles reaches role assignment.
claims.quote: select Manage. select Environments, and then select an environment from the list. Select Settings. Select Users + permissions, and then select Users. On the Users page select a user, and then select Manage security roles.
claims.fix: Keep the path. Append to controls[0].note: 'This user screen manages only direct role assignments; roles inherited through group-team membership are managed separately.' The qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/assign-security-roles.

claims.claim: POST /api/data/v9.0/systemusers(azureactivedirectoryobjectid=<user object ID>)/systemuserroles_association/$ref assigns a role to a Microsoft Entra ID group user.
claims.quote: An administrator can assign a security role to a Microsoft Entra ID group user. POST [Organization URI]/api/data/v9.0/systemusers(azureactivedirectoryobjectid=<user object ID>)/systemuserroles_association/$ref

claims.claim: The role-assignment request body sets @odata.id to the role URI.
claims.quote: "@odata.id":"[Organization URI]/api/data/v9.0/roles(<role ID>)"

claims.claim: Copilot Service admin center > Customer Support > Quality management > Quality evaluation > Manage > Evaluation summary > Regenerate evaluation summary reaches the regeneration setting.
claims.quote: In Copilot Service admin center, go to Customer Support > Quality management. Select Manage for Quality evaluation. In the Evaluation summary section, turn on Regenerate evaluation summary.

claims.claim: PATCH /msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigs(<msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigid>) updates an Evaluation Global Config record and its summary-regeneration flag.
claims.quote: Update: PATCH /msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigs(msdyn_evaluationglobalconfigid). Writable columns/attributes: msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration. Description: Global flag to enable or disable the summary regeneration feature.

claims.claim: The deciding request-body property msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration is Boolean and enables or disables summary regeneration.
claims.quote: Description | Global flag to enable or disable the summary regeneration feature. LogicalName | msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration. Type | Boolean. True Label | Yes. False Label | No.

claims.claim: Disabling Regenerate evaluation summary hides the Generate Summary option from evaluators.
claims.quote: If you disable the option: The Generate Summary option is hidden from evaluators.

claims.claim: The regeneration setting controls evaluators' ability to generate manual summaries or regenerate completed AI-assisted and AI agent evaluation summaries.
claims.quote: If you disable the option: Evaluators can't generate summaries for manual evaluations or regenerate summaries for completed AI-assisted and AI agent evaluations.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly distinguish whether disabling the regeneration setting also stops automatic regeneration on submission after an edit.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 Regenerate evaluation summary disable automatic regeneration submission msdyn_enablesummaryregeneration. Read Manage quality evaluation, Use evaluations and Evaluation Global Config; no separate statement about the automatic trigger when disabled.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents the Submission Overridden flag but no audit event names specifically for submitted-evaluation overrides.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 quality evaluation override submitted evaluation audit event prvOverrideSubmittedEval audit history. Read Use evaluations, Manage quality evaluation, Evaluation and EvaluationHistory references; no override-specific audit event names.
